items.body: Parser launches are not bound to `sessionId`; the property is never passed to Python. A delayed launch/restart can increment or clear a newer session’s state, especially across the 1s/4s backoff.
items.suggestion: Pass the expected session ID and validate it under the state lock before every mutation and after backoff.
items.title: Parser launches are not bound to `sessionId`; the property is never passed to Python

items.body: An unexpected exit before `parser_active` is observed relaunches the normal path, bypassing restart accounting and backoff. Lock contention also exits immediately and triggers repeated process launches without consuming the restart budget.
items.suggestion: Treat every unexpected owned-process exit as `--restart`, distinguish singleton contention from a crash, and add tests for pre-marker failure and lock contention.
items.title: An unexpected exit before `parser_active` is observed relaunches the normal path, bypassing restart accounting and backoff

items.body: Mid-session enable only changes configuration. After a prior disable, `finish_requested=true` and `session_ready=false`, so re-enabling starts neither parser nor capture. A cold startup already focused with no control marker has the same problem.
items.suggestion: When enabling while focused, initialize/resume a session and publish readiness after confirming notification mute is armed.
items.title: Mid-session enable only changes configuration

items.body: Toast fields and the pending queue are unbounded, and `cmd_capture_ping()` uses unbounded `sys.stdin.read()`. Large or flooded notifications can exhaust QML memory or exceed argv limits before the 64-KiB JSONL trim applies.
items.suggestion: Bound serialized payload size and queue depth in QML, and enforce a bounded read independently in Python.
items.title: Toast fields and the pending queue are unbounded, and `cmd_capture_ping()` uses unbounded `sys

items.body: JSONL is replaced before `next_seq` is persisted. If the control write fails, the record remains but the next capture reuses its sequence number, violating durable monotonic sequencing and potentially hiding records from the parser cursor.
items.suggestion: Persist sequence allocation before publishing the record, permitting gaps on append failure, or use a transaction/journal that cannot expose duplicate sequence numbers.
items.title: JSONL is replaced before `next_seq` is persisted

items.body: After checking the expected session, the parser calls `clear_parser_running()`, which reacquires the lock and mutates whichever session is then current.
items.suggestion: Pass the expected session into cleanup and validate it while holding the mutation lock.
items.title: After checking the expected session, the parser calls `clear_parser_running()`, which reacquires the lock and mutates whichever session is then current

items.body: Exit code 2 merely returns from `onExited`. The 250 ms timer then calls `syncParser()` again with `parserOwned=true`, repeatedly launching `--restart`.
items.suggestion: Suppress launches for that session after a busy exit until the existing parser or control marker changes.
items.title: Exit code 2 merely returns from `onExited`

items.body: `mark_parser_active()` and `apply_parser_restart()` validate only the session ID, then clear `finish_requested` without requiring ready/open/focused/enabled state.
items.suggestion: Atomically validate all start conditions and never clear a finish request during parser startup or restart.
items.title: `mark_parser_active()` and `apply_parser_restart()` validate only the session ID, then clear `finish_requested` without requiring ready/open/focused/enabled state

items.body: Enabling while focused directly calls `arm_summary_after_mute()` even if mute previously failed.
items.suggestion: Verify or reapply notification blocking and publish readiness only after success.
items.title: Enabling while focused directly calls `arm_summary_after_mute()` even if mute previously failed

items.body: After the initial `is_focus()` check, `_apply_notification_block()` returns True without muting when focus has become off. `arm_summary_after_mute()` then republishes ready.
items.suggestion: Bind ready publication to the expected session and, under the state lock, require focus still on, summaries enabled, and finish not requested unless this is an explicit resume.
items.title: After the initial `is_focus()` check, `_apply_notification_block()` returns True without muting when focus has become off

items.body: Finish does not clear `captureQueue`, and `capture-ping` receives no expected session. Queued session-A toasts can append to session B.
items.suggestion: Stop queued/in-flight capture when readiness is lost and pass the enqueue-time session ID to `capture-ping`.
items.title: Finish does not clear `captureQueue`, and `capture-ping` receives no expected session

items.body: An old-session parser exit can start the current session as `--restart`.
items.suggestion: Track the launched process session and reset ownership on session changes.
items.title: An old-session parser exit can start the current session as `--restart`

items.body: Clean reset overwrites the old control object before reaping `agent_pid`; consequently the old child is never signalled.
items.suggestion: Preserve and reap the previous control’s child before replacing its state, with PID identity validation.
items.title: Clean reset overwrites the old control object before reaping `agent_pid`; consequently the old child is never signalled

items.body: Ping and control temporary files are created with umask-derived permissions, published, and only then chmodded. Notification text can therefore exist as `0644`, and chmod failures are silently ignored.
items.suggestion: Create the temporary descriptor as `0600`, verify permissions, then atomically rename it.
items.title: Ping and control temporary files are created with umask-derived permissions, published, and only then chmodded

items.body: Disabling summaries neither clears `captureQueue` nor cancels the in-flight capture helper. Because the helper does not verify `agent_summaries`, queued data can still be appended after opt-out.
items.suggestion: Clear/cancel capture work on disable and enforce the enabled setting in `capture_ping()`.
items.title: Disabling summaries neither clears `captureQueue` nor cancels the in-flight capture helper

items.body: QML reads `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, while Python always uses `~/.config`. With a non-default XDG configuration directory, capture and parser disagree about whether summaries are enabled.
items.title: QML reads `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, while Python always uses `~/

items.body: The Off path ignores `update_focus_config()` failure and requests finish anyway.
items.suggestion: Request finish only when the configuration update succeeds.
items.title: The Off path ignores `update_focus_config()` failure and requests finish anyway
